description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thelwatta,  Hikkaduwa D/S Division, Galle District   - Cad. Map No. 810089
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for various parcels in the Hikkaduwa area. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, owners, and encumbrances, making it clearly a land-related gazette under Type 4 classification.
